work only local kick 
open source
scripts.script:
local p = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local o = getrawmetatable(game)
local s = o.__namecall
local w = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
    local m = getnamecallmethod()
    if m == "Kick" and self == p then
        return
    end
    return s(self, ...)
end)
setreadonly(o, false)
o.__namecall = w
setreadonly(o, true)
print("Load")

Let's set the record straight for those who keep throwing around the word "malware" without a shred of evidence.

'MZXHUB' is NOT malware. Period.

A key system is an access gate, not a virus. It verifies users before running, malware does the opposite. It runs silently and does harm behind your back. These are two completely different things.

MZXHUB goes through ScriptBlox's official review process. Three to five reviewers test it on their own machines and accounts. If it were malicious, it would've been deleted already. It's still up because it's clean.

No obfuscation is hiding a malicious payload. If you're going to call something malware, point to the actual harmful code. The webhook, the data exfiltration, the HttpPost. Or drop the claim entirely.

"It asked for a key so it's a virus" is not an argument. That's like calling a locked door a burglary. The key system exists to prevent leeching and unauthorized use, not to harm anyone.

False reports have real consequences. They get legitimate scripts deleted, waste reviewer time, hurt the developer who put hours into this, and mislead new users who don't know any better.

If you genuinely suspect something, do it properly. Read the code, or report it to ScriptBlox staff with actual evidence. Don't just repeat "it's malware" because someone else said it in the comments.

Accusations without proof aren't warnings. They're noise. Stop spreading claims you can't back up.

- MZXHUB OWNER
